47: /**
48:  * Tri-state project capability overlay. Lives in PROJECT settings only and
49:  * layers over the global baseline (disabledSkills / disabledPlugins /
50:  * mcpServers.<name>.enabled / disabledAgents). NOT a second denylist:
51:  *   - "on"      → force enabled (even if globally disabled)
52:  *   - "off"     → force disabled (even if globally enabled)
53:  *   - "inherit" → take the global baseline. We don't persist "inherit"; an
54:  *                 absent key means inherit. See the project-scoped
55:  *                 capabilities design (spec §4).
56:  */
57: export const CapabilityOverrideSchema = z.enum(["inherit", "on", "off"]);
58: export type CapabilityOverride = z.infer<typeof CapabilityOverrideSchema>;
59: 
60: export const CapabilityOverridesSchema = z
61:   .object({
62:     skills: z.record(CapabilityOverrideSchema).optional(),
63:     plugins: z.record(CapabilityOverrideSchema).optional(),
64:     agents: z.record(CapabilityOverrideSchema).optional(),
65:     mcp: z.record(CapabilityOverrideSchema).optional(),
66:     builtin: z.record(CapabilityOverrideSchema).optional(),
67:     /** Per-project Pet capability preferences layered over the user baseline. */
68:     pet: z.record(CapabilityOverrideSchema).optional(),
69:     /**
70:      * Per-hook overlay for PLUGIN-provided hooks, keyed by
71:      * `pluginHookKey()` (`<plugin>:<RawEvent>:<command>`). Finer-grained
72:      * than `plugins` (which kills a whole plugin): "off" suppresses one
73:      * hook for this project only. Only "off" is meaningful today — plugin
74:      * hooks have no global disable list to force back "on" from.
75:      */
76:     pluginHooks: z.record(CapabilityOverrideSchema).optional(),
77:   })
78:   .optional();
79: export type CapabilityOverrides = z.infer<typeof CapabilityOverridesSchema>;
